label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Charles Schwab Withdrawals
items.text: Two major recent winners including Brooks Koepka withdrew from the Charles Schwab Challenge just days before it starts.

items.headline: Bryson Shocked by LIV Cut
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau said he was shocked by Saudi PIF pulling LIV Golf funding quickly, but remains optimistic about new investors and the league's future.

items.headline: DeChambeau Responds to Critics
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau says he embraces both praise and criticism, focusing on growing his brand and inspiring youth despite online negativity.
